WITH ranked_containers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_temp_stability_score,
        -- Assuming Container Risk Index (CRI) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS container_risk_index, 
        -- Assuming Risk Rank is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS risk_rank,
        dl.logflag AS sensor_data_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(sd.tempstabidx) DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        Container c
    JOIN 
        SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        DataLogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
    GROUP BY 
        c.containregistry, dl.logflag
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    max_temp_stability_score,
    container_risk_index,
    risk_rank,
    sensor_data_status,
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', MAX(sd.tempdevcount),
        'CritEvents', MAX(sd.critevents),
        'TempStabIdx', MAX(sd.tempstabidx),
        'CoolRemainPct', c.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity (TBS) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        'TempBreachSeverity', 0
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    ranked_containers rc
JOIN 
    Container c ON rc.container_id = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE 
    rc.row_num <= 10
GROUP BY 
    rc.container_id, rc.max_temp_stability_score, rc.container_risk_index, rc.risk_rank, rc.sensor_data_status, c.coolremainpct

WITH ranked_containers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_temp_stability_score,
        -- Assuming Container Risk Index (CRI) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS container_risk_index, 
        -- Assuming Risk Rank is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS risk_rank,
        dl.logflag AS sensor_data_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(sd.tempstabidx) DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        Container c
    JOIN 
        SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        DataLogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
    GROUP BY 
        c.containregistry, dl.logflag
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    max_temp_stability_score,
    container_risk_index,
    risk_rank,
    sensor_data_status,
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', MAX(sd.tempdevcount),
        'CritEvents', MAX(sd.critevents),
        'TempStabIdx', MAX(sd.tempstabidx),
        'CoolRemainPct', c.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity (TBS) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        'TempBreachSeverity', 0
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    ranked_containers rc
JOIN 
    Container c ON rc.container_id = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE 
    rc.row_num <= 10
GROUP BY 
    rc.container_id, rc.max_temp_stability_score, rc.container_risk_index, rc.risk_rank, rc.sensor_data_status, c.coolremainpct
ORDER BY 
    rc.row_num;
